name: KRATER
description: Worms-style artillery with moles: destructible maps in three climates, eleven weapons from bazooka to airstrike, wind, crates, hot-seat teams and CPU players that simulate their shots.

name: ENCORE
description: A survivor roguelite where every weapon is an instrument on a 16-step sequencer: build a band, and the song of the run grows with it, until THE SILENCE comes.

name: KABOOM
description: Bomberman-style arena battles: arcade against CPU bombers or up to four players, three arenas with warps and conveyor belts, nine power-ups and skull curses.

name: PONGMAN
description: Pong through a Pac-Man maze: steer the ball with your paddle, dodge ghosts, send invaders down the other lane, mind the gorilla.

name: VEKTOR
description: Raiden-style vertical shooter: five stages from the jungle coast to a volcano, PixelLab sprite art, vulcan or laser, bombs, medals and five bosses.

name: REBOUND
description: Brick-breaking arcade game: paint the ball, mix colours into power-ups, pixel-picture walls, or two paddles at once.

name: SNACKMAN
description: Arcade maze game: procedural mazes, snacks cooked from ingredients, play the ghost, or the lights out.

name: SCALES
description: NES-style snake game in a musical labyrinth.

name: jtris
description: NES-style pixel-art block puzzle game.

name: W.A.L.D.
description: Wächter Aller Lebenden Dinge: a pixel-art adventure by Tilman, Jonas and Leonel.

name: Crosscountry
description: Daily geography grid: nine countries that fit both their row and their column, and the rarer the answer the better.

name: Chemgrid
description: Daily periodic-table grid: nine elements that fit both their row and their column.

name: terran
description: Street View guessing without the extras: walk, look or one still photo, themed games, a daily and challenge links.

name: xess
description: Chess puzzles on non-standard boards: variable sizes, odd grids, blocked squares. Works offline.

name: opener
description: Learn chess openings by playing them, against a human-like opponent with an opening explorer.

name: Stack
description: Magic: The Gathering deck builder with rules-enforced play, locally or against a friend over the internet, no server.

name: Mensura
description: Die sieben Urmaße: a maths adventure for grades 5 and 6 (German).

name: voku
description: Five-minute in-class vocabulary sprints for German students learning English.

name: Oberkurs Informatik: Überblick
description: Interactive LiaScript course on Python, Linux and programming basics (German).

name: Unterkurs Informatik: Überblick
description: Interactive LiaScript course on logic and number systems (German).

name: MODULAR
description: A pixel-art modular synth in the browser: patch drum machines, sequencers, synth voices, LFOs and effects with cables, play live from keyboard or MIDI, record WAVs and share patches as links.

name: Straussi
description: Finder for Straussenwirtschaften in Südbaden: who is open, where they are, what they serve, on a map.

name: microtools
description: Simple link-based tools: date polls, note and file sharing, expense splitting, one-time secrets.

name: FRACZILLA
description: GPU deep-zoom fractal explorer in the spirit of the DOS classics: 26 fractal types zooming to 10^30× via perturbation theory, curated journeys and Julia sets, a lean-back tour, color cycling and video export.

name: tlog
description: Markdown-first knowledge outliner for the terminal, with a desktop app. Plain files, no database.

name: docex
description: Word documents through Markdown: edit in the terminal, any editor or the desktop app, and only your changes go back into the .docx, as tracked changes. Built for reviewing other people's edits.

name: mdeck
description: Slides as a plain Markdown file: an AI assistant writes them from your old decks and notes, you present in the browser and share one HTML file or a PDF.

name: mdeck themes
description: Themes and palettes for mdeck, tried on a sample deck in light and dark, with each theme's settings as sliders, and installed with one command.

name: localdev
description: Stable *.localhost URLs for local dev servers: registry, reverse proxy, dashboard.

name: omapic
description: Tiny keyboard-driven image viewer and organizer for Omarchy / Arch Linux (Rust + GTK4).

name: MagiClip
description: The magic clipboard: press a key, pick a prompt, and the copied text goes through Claude or a local model; read the answer or let it replace the clipboard.

name: legokit
description: Generates LEGO sets from real parts: models, parts lists, renders, instruction booklets and build films.

name: Mars
description: Dark Omarchy theme from HiRISE Mars imagery: slate grey with a Martian red accent.

name: Carbonfox
description: Omarchy port of the carbonfox flavour of nightfox.nvim.

name: Solarized Dark
description: Omarchy theme from Ethan Schoonover's original Solarized spec.
